In this section, we will perform a differential expression analysis using the DESeq2 package. We will compare the expression of genes between

```{r }
dds_roots
attr(dds_roots, "modelMatrix")

res <- results(dds_roots)
res
head(res)
resultsNames(dds)
dds_roots$Genotype
dds_roots$Sample_ID #the default reference level is: "AUZBasalRoots_day5_RedHawk"
```

### Note on factor levels: 
By default, R will choose a reference level for factors based on alphabetical order. Then, if you never tell the DESeq2 functions which level you want to compare against (e.g. which level represents the control group), the comparisons will be based on the alphabetical order of the levels. 
There are two solutions: you can either explicitly tell results which comparison to make using the contrast argument (this will be shown later), or you can explicitly set the factors levels. 
In order to see the change of reference levels reflected in the results names, you need to either run DESeq or nbinomWaldTest/nbinomLRT after the re-leveling operation. 
Setting the factor levels can be done in two ways, either using factor or relevel:

```{r}
dds_roots$Sample_ID #the default reference level is: AUZBasalRoots_day5_RedHawk

#If want to change the reference level: for example to "RootCrown_day2_RedHawk"
#dds_roots$Sample_ID  <- relevel(dds_roots$Sample_ID, ref = "RootCrown_day2_RedHawk")
#dds_roots$Sample_ID #the new reference level is: RootCrown_day2_RedHawk 

#Need to run DeSeq again after leveling the factors
#dds_roots <- DESeq(dds_roots)
#res <- results(dds_roots)

head(res)
resultsNames(dds_roots)

#Test differentially expressed genes using a sample contrast
all_genes_results <- results(dds_roots, contrast = c("Sample_ID",                      # name of the factor
                                  "AUZBasalRoots_day5_Stampede",    # name of the numerator level for fold change
                                  "AUZBasalRoots_day5_RedHawk"))  # name of the denominator level  (this is the reference level)
all_equal(res, all_genes_results)

#Extracting the table of differential genes
head(all_genes_results)                
mcols(all_genes_results)

# False discovery rates

library(dplyr)

# threshold of p = 0.05
all_genes_results %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
  dim()
#3205 genes are differentially expressed at a threshold of p = 0.05

resultsNames(dds_roots)
resLFC_AUZBRStRh <- lfcShrink(dds = dds_roots, 
                  res = all_genes_results,
                  type = "apeglm",
                  coef = "Sample_ID_AUZBasalRoots_day5_Stampede_vs_AUZBasalRoots_day5_RedHawk") # name or number of the coefficient (LFC) to shrink

```

## Count upregulated and downregulated genes

DE counts table adding columns for:

Upregulated genes (log2FC > 0, padj ≤ 0.05)
Downregulated genes (log2FC < 0, padj ≤ 0.05)
Threshold upregulated genes (log2FC > 2, padj ≤ 0.05)
Threshold downregulated genes (log2FC < -2, padj ≤ 0.05)
Highly upregulated genes (top 10% log2FC, padj ≤ 0.05)
Highly downregulated genes (bottom 10% log2FC, padj ≤ 0.05)

```{r}

# Load the contrasts data frame
contrasts_df <- read.csv("Results_nf_pipelines/ResultsDiffExp_nfcore_Repblock_onlyroots_shiny/tables/contrast/contrasts_pairwise_TissueDayGenotype_Rep_onlyroots.csv")

# Ensure 'id' column exists in the contrasts table
if(!"id" %in% colnames(contrasts_df)) stop("The contrasts data frame does not contain an 'id' column.")

# Check available IDs
print(contrasts_df$id)

# Load required library
library(dplyr)

# Define upregulation and downregulation thresholds
logFC_threshold <- 0  # Genes with log2FoldChange > 0 are upregulated, < 0 are downregulated
padj_threshold <- 0.05  # Significant DEGs threshold

# Function to count upregulated and downregulated genes
count_DEGs <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(padj <= padj_threshold) %>%  # Keep only significant DEGs
    summarise(
      Upregulated = sum(log2FoldChange > logFC_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
      Downregulated = sum(log2FoldChange < logFC_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# Apply function to all differential expression results
DE_counts_list <- lapply(de_results_list, count_DEGs)

# Convert list to a data frame
DE_counts_table <- bind_rows(DE_counts_list, .id = "Contrast")

# Ensure 'Contrast' column matches 'id' in the contrast table
DE_counts_table <- DE_counts_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(id = Contrast)  # Rename for easy matching

# Merge with the contrasts data frame to retain order
DE_counts_table <- contrasts_df %>%
  select(id) %>%  # Keep only 'id' to enforce order
  left_join(DE_counts_table, by = "id")  # Merge while preserving order

# Print the ordered table
print(DE_counts_table)

# Save the table as a CSV file
#write.csv(DE_counts_table, "1.DEAnalysis/output/DEG_counts_ordered_by_contrasts.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Function to count upregulated, downregulated, and highly regulated genes
count_DEGs_extended <- function(df) {
  padj_threshold <- 0.05  # Significance threshold
  logFC_standard <- 0  # Standard up/down regulation
  logFC_threshold <- 2  # Threshold for strong up/down regulation

  # Filter significant DEGs
  df_filtered <- df %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)

  # Compute top and bottom 10% log2FC thresholds
  logFC_top10 <- quantile(df_filtered$log2FoldChange, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
  logFC_bottom10 <- quantile(df_filtered$log2FoldChange, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Count differentially expressed genes with clear, R-safe column names
  data.frame(
    Upregulated_logFC_gt_0 = sum(df_filtered$log2FoldChange > logFC_standard, na.rm = TRUE),
    Downregulated_logFC_lt_0 = sum(df_filtered$log2FoldChange < logFC_standard, na.rm = TRUE),
    Threshold_Upregulated_logFC_gt_2 = sum(df_filtered$log2FoldChange > logFC_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    Threshold_Downregulated_logFC_lt_neg2 = sum(df_filtered$log2FoldChange < -logFC_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highly_Upregulated_top10_logFC = sum(df_filtered$log2FoldChange > logFC_top10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highly_Downregulated_bottom10_logFC = sum(df_filtered$log2FoldChange < logFC_bottom10, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}


# Apply function to all DE results
DE_counts_list_extended <- lapply(de_results_list, count_DEGs_extended)

# Convert list to a dataframe

assign_context <- function(contrast_id) {
  if (grepl("RedHawk_vs_Stampede$", contrast_id)) {
    return("between_genotypes_within_tissue_day")
  } else if (grepl("day2_vs_day5$", contrast_id)) {
    return("across_days_within_tissue_genotype")
  } else if (grepl(".*_vs_.*", contrast_id)) {
    return("between_tissues_within_genotype_day")
  } else {
    return("other")  # Default category for unclassified cases
  }
}

# Apply the function to the `id` column in DE_counts_table_extended
DE_counts_table_extended <- DE_counts_table_extended %>%
  mutate(context = sapply(id, assign_context))

# Print the first few rows to verify
head(DE_counts_table_extended)


# Save the updated DE counts table as a CSV file
#write.csv(DE_counts_table_extended, "1.DEAnalysis/output/DEG_counts_extended.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Load necessary library
library(dplyr)

# Ensure the id column is a character
DE_counts_table_extended$id <- as.character(DE_counts_table_extended$id)

# Define the function to assign Group based on "id"
assign_group <- function(id) {
  # Assign fixed categories based on row positions
  if (id %in% DE_counts_table_extended$id[1:3]) {
    return("Day2")
  } else if (id %in% DE_counts_table_extended$id[4:11]) {
    return("Day5")
  } else if (id %in% DE_counts_table_extended$id[c(12, 14, 16)]) {
    return("RedHawk")
  } else if (id %in% DE_counts_table_extended$id[c(13, 15, 17)]) {
    return("Stampede")
  } else {
    # Extract the second-to-last and last part after splitting by underscore
    parts <- unlist(strsplit(id, "_"))
    if (length(parts) >= 2) {
      return(paste(parts[length(parts) - 1], parts[length(parts)], sep = "_"))
    } else {
      return(id)  # If less than 2 parts, return the original id
    }
  }
}

# Apply the function to the "id" column using dplyr::mutate()
DE_counts_table_extended <- DE_counts_table_extended %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = sapply(id, assign_group))

# Display first few rows to check
head(DE_counts_table_extended)
unique(DE_counts_table_extended$Group)
```

## Identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs)

Unique in the upregulated genes for each contrast
Unique in the downregulated genes for each contrast
Shared between upregulated and downregulated genes across contrasts within each group: First identify shared genes within the group and then check which of those shared genes appear in each contrast.
Group was defined for each contrast based on tissue comparison in DEG_counts_extended.csv.

Find shared genes within each group first (Shared_Upregulated & Shared_Downregulated).
For each contrast, determine which shared genes appear.
Update summary_long to count shared genes per contrast.

```{r}
identify_unique_shared_DEGs_grouped <- function(de_list, contrast_groups, padj_threshold = 0.05, logFC_threshold = 0) {
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (group_name in names(contrast_groups)) {
    
    group_contrasts <- contrast_groups[[group_name]]
    
    # Extract DEGs for selected contrasts
    degs_group <- list()
    
    for (contrast in group_contrasts) {
      if (contrast %in% names(de_list)) {
        df <- de_list[[contrast]] %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)
        upregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange > logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        downregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange < -logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        
        degs_group[[contrast]] <- list(
          Upregulated = upregulated,
          Downregulated = downregulated
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Identify shared genes across all contrasts in the group
    shared_up <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(degs_group, function(x) x$Upregulated))
    shared_down <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(degs_group, function(x) x$Downregulated))

    # Identify genes unique to each contrast in the group
    unique_up_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(degs_group[[contrast]]$Upregulated, unlist(degs_group[names(degs_group) != contrast], use.names = FALSE))
    })
    names(unique_up_contrast) <- names(degs_group)

    unique_down_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(degs_group[[contrast]]$Downregulated, unlist(degs_group[names(degs_group) != contrast], use.names = FALSE))
    })
    names(unique_down_contrast) <- names(degs_group)
    
    # Store results
    results_list[[group_name]] <- list(
      Shared_Upregulated = shared_up,
      Shared_Downregulated = shared_down,
      Unique_Upregulated_by_contrast = unique_up_contrast,
      Unique_Downregulated_by_contrast = unique_down_contrast
    )
  }
  
  return(results_list)
}

# Contrast groups using Group column from DE_counts_table_extended
contrast_groups <- DE_counts_table_extended %>%
  dplyr::select(id, Group)  # Keeping both ID and Group for reference

# Convert to a named list
contrast_groups <- split(contrast_groups$id, contrast_groups$Group)

# Print the structure to verify
contrast_groups
str(contrast_groups)


DEG_results_grouped <- identify_unique_shared_DEGs_grouped(de_results_list, contrast_groups)


library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Convert the lists into data frames for easy export
unique_up_by_contrast_df <- map_df(names(DEG_results_grouped), function(group) {
  data.frame(
    Group = group, 
    Contrast = rep(names(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Upregulated_by_contrast), 
                   sapply(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Upregulated_by_contrast, length)),
    Gene = unlist(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Upregulated_by_contrast, use.names = FALSE),
    Category = "Unique_Upregulated"
  )
})

unique_down_by_contrast_df <- map_df(names(DEG_results_grouped), function(group) {
  data.frame(
    Group = group, 
    Contrast = rep(names(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Downregulated_by_contrast), 
                   sapply(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Downregulated_by_contrast, length)),
    Gene = unlist(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Downregulated_by_contrast, use.names = FALSE),
    Category = "Unique_Downregulated"
  )
})


# Identify shared genes by contrast (genes that are shared across the group but found in a specific contrast)
shared_up_by_contrast_df <- map_df(names(DEG_results_grouped), function(group) {
  shared_genes_group <- DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Shared_Upregulated  # All shared upregulated genes in the group
  
  map_df(names(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Upregulated_by_contrast), function(contrast) {
    contrast_genes <- DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Upregulated_by_contrast[[contrast]]  # Get genes in contrast
    
    shared_in_contrast <- intersect(shared_genes_group, contrast_genes)  # Shared genes present in this contrast
    
    if (length(shared_in_contrast) > 0) {
      return(data.frame(Group = group, Contrast = contrast, Gene = shared_in_contrast, Category = "Shared_Upregulated"))
    } else {
      return(data.frame(Group = character(0), Contrast = character(0), Gene = character(0), Category = character(0)))  # Empty df if no matches
    }
  })
})

shared_down_by_contrast_df <- map_df(names(DEG_results_grouped), function(group) {
  shared_genes_group <- DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Shared_Downregulated  # All shared downregulated genes in the group
  
  map_df(names(DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Downregulated_by_contrast), function(contrast) {
    contrast_genes <- DEG_results_grouped[[group]]$Unique_Downregulated_by_contrast[[contrast]]  # Get genes in contrast
    
    shared_in_contrast <- intersect(shared_genes_group, contrast_genes)  # Shared genes present in this contrast
    
    if (length(shared_in_contrast) > 0) {
      return(data.frame(Group = group, Contrast = contrast, Gene = shared_in_contrast, Category = "Shared_Downregulated"))
    } else {
      return(data.frame(Group = character(0), Contrast = character(0), Gene = character(0), Category = character(0)))  # Empty df if no matches
    }
  })
})


# Save results
write.csv(unique_up_by_contrast_df, "1.DEAnalysis/output/Unique_Upregulated_by_Contrast.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(unique_down_by_contrast_df, "1.DEAnalysis/output/Unique_Downregulated_by_Contrast.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(shared_up_by_contrast_df, "1.DEAnalysis/output/Shared_Upregulated_by_Contrast.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(shared_down_by_contrast_df, "1.DEAnalysis/output/Shared_Downregulated_by_Contrast.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
identify_unique_shared_DEGs_grouped <- function(de_list, contrast_groups, padj_threshold = 0.05, logFC_threshold = 0) {
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (group_name in names(contrast_groups)) {
    
    group_contrasts <- contrast_groups[[group_name]]
    
    # Extract DEGs for selected contrasts
    degs_group <- list()
    
    for (contrast in group_contrasts) {
      if (contrast %in% names(de_list)) {
        df <- de_list[[contrast]] %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)
        upregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange > logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        downregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange < -logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        
        degs_group[[contrast]] <- list(
          Upregulated = upregulated,
          Downregulated = downregulated
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Identify shared genes across all contrasts in the group
    shared_up <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(degs_group, function(x) x$Upregulated))
    shared_down <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(degs_group, function(x) x$Downregulated))
    
    # Identify shared genes by contrast (should be zero if shared by group)
    shared_up_by_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(intersect(degs_group[[contrast]]$Upregulated, shared_up), shared_up)
    })
    names(shared_up_by_contrast) <- names(degs_group)
    
    shared_down_by_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(intersect(degs_group[[contrast]]$Downregulated, shared_down), shared_down)
    })
    names(shared_down_by_contrast) <- names(degs_group)
    
    # Identify genes unique to each contrast in the group
    unique_up_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(degs_group[[contrast]]$Upregulated, unlist(degs_group[names(degs_group) != contrast], use.names = FALSE))
    })
    names(unique_up_contrast) <- names(degs_group)
    
    unique_down_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(degs_group[[contrast]]$Downregulated, unlist(degs_group[names(degs_group) != contrast], use.names = FALSE))
    })
    names(unique_down_contrast) <- names(degs_group)
    
    # Store results
    results_list[[group_name]] <- list(
      Shared_Upregulated_by_Group = shared_up,
      Shared_Downregulated_by_Group = shared_down,
      Shared_Upregulated_by_Contrast = shared_up_by_contrast,
      Shared_Downregulated_by_Contrast = shared_down_by_contrast,
      Unique_Upregulated_by_Contrast = unique_up_contrast,
      Unique_Downregulated_by_Contrast = unique_down_contrast
    )
  }
  
  return(results_list)
}
```

```{r}
# Apply function

# Convert lists into data frames for export
save_deg_results <- function(results, category, filename) {
  df_list <- map(names(results), function(group) {
    gene_list <- results[[group]][[category]]
    
    # Handle missing category
    if (is.null(gene_list) || length(gene_list) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(
        Group = group,
        Contrast = NA,
        Gene = NA,
        Count = 0,  # Ensure numeric type
        Category = category
      ))
    }
    
    # Extract contrast names and gene counts
    contrast_names <- names(gene_list)
    contrast_lengths <- sapply(gene_list, length)
    
    # Ensure valid contrast names
    if (is.null(contrast_names)) {
      contrast_names <- rep(NA, length(gene_list))
    }
    
    # If no genes exist in any contrast, return a single row with Count = 0
    if (all(contrast_lengths == 0)) {
      return(data.frame(
        Group = group,
        Contrast = NA,
        Gene = NA,
        Count = 0,  # Ensure numeric type
        Category = category
      ))
    }
    
    # Construct dataframe ensuring valid row lengths
    gene_values <- unlist(gene_list, use.names = FALSE)
    contrast_rep <- rep(contrast_names, contrast_lengths)

    # If there are no genes but contrast names exist, handle gracefully
    if (length(gene_values) == 0) {
      gene_values <- NA
      contrast_rep <- NA
    }

    df <- data.frame(
      Group = rep(group, length(gene_values)),  # Repeat group name
      Contrast = contrast_rep,  # Expand contrast names
      Gene = gene_values,  # Flatten gene list
      Category = category,  # Assign category
      Count = as.numeric(contrast_lengths[match(contrast_rep, contrast_names)])  # Ensure numeric count
    )
    
    # Replace NA counts with 0
    df$Count[is.na(df$Count)] <- 0
    
    return(df)
  })
  
  # Combine all results
  df <- bind_rows(df_list)

  # Ensure numeric format for Count
  df$Count <- as.numeric(df$Count)
  
  # Write the CSV file
  write.csv(df, filename, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#Function to identify unique and shared DEGs by group
identify_unique_shared_DEGs_grouped <- function(de_list, contrast_groups, padj_threshold = 0.05, logFC_threshold = 0) {
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (group_name in names(contrast_groups)) {
    
    group_contrasts <- contrast_groups[[group_name]]
    
    # Extract DEGs for selected contrasts
    degs_group <- list()
    
    for (contrast in group_contrasts) {
      if (contrast %in% names(de_list)) {
        df <- de_list[[contrast]] %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)
        upregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange > logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        downregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange < -logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        
        degs_group[[contrast]] <- list(
          Upregulated = upregulated,
          Downregulated = downregulated
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Identify shared genes across all contrasts in the group
    shared_up <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(degs_group, function(x) x$Upregulated))
    shared_down <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(degs_group, function(x) x$Downregulated))
    
    # Assign shared genes to each contrast
    shared_up_by_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      intersect(degs_group[[contrast]]$Upregulated, shared_up)
    })
    names(shared_up_by_contrast) <- names(degs_group)

    shared_down_by_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {

    # Identify genes unique to each contrast in the group
    unique_up_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
      setdiff(degs_group[[contrast]]$Upregulated, unlist(degs_group[names(degs_group) != contrast], use.names = FALSE))
    })

    unique_down_contrast <- lapply(names(degs_group), function(contrast) {
```

## Visualization of unique and shared DEGs by group for tissue comparison
Venn diagrams for shared upregulated and downregulated genes across groups

Each contrast contains the corresponding genes, and the Venn diagram should compare contrasts within each group separately for upregulated and downregulated genes.

```{r}
library(VennDiagram)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Function to extract DEGs (Upregulated and Downregulated) for each group
extract_DEGs_by_group <- function(de_list, contrast_groups, padj_threshold = 0.05, logFC_threshold = 0) {
  group_DEGs <- list()

  for (group in names(contrast_groups)) {
    upregulated_list <- list()
    downregulated_list <- list()

    contrasts <- contrast_groups[[group]]  # Use predefined contrast groups

    for (contrast in contrasts) {
      if (contrast %in% names(de_list)) {  # Ensure the contrast exists in the DE results
        df <- de_list[[contrast]] %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)

        upregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange > logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)
        downregulated <- df %>% filter(log2FoldChange < -logFC_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id)

        upregulated_list[[contrast]] <- upregulated
        downregulated_list[[contrast]] <- downregulated
      }
    }

    group_DEGs[[group]] <- list(
      Upregulated = upregulated_list,
      Downregulated = downregulated_list
    )
  }

  return(group_DEGs)
}

# Function to plot proportional Venn diagrams
plot_venn_diagram <- function(deg_list, title) {
  # Remove empty sets and NULL values
  deg_list <- deg_list[lengths(deg_list) > 0]

  # Ensure at least two groups exist before plotting
  if (length(deg_list) < 2) {
    message(paste("Skipping", title, "as it has less than two valid groups."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Ensure all elements are lists of genes
  deg_list <- lapply(deg_list, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(character(0))  # Convert NULLs to empty character vectors
    if (is.list(x)) return(unlist(x))     # Flatten nested lists
    return(x)
  })

  # Define colors dynamically based on the number of sets
  colors <- c("red", "blue", "green", "yellow", "purple")[1:length(deg_list)]

  venn.plot <- tryCatch({
    venn.diagram(
      x = deg_list,
      category.names = names(deg_list),
      filename = NULL,
      fill = colors,
      alpha = 0.5,
      cat.col = "black",
      main = title,
      cex = 1.2,
      cat.cex = 1
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error in plotting Venn diagram for", title, ":", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })

  if (!is.null(venn.plot)) {
    grid.draw(venn.plot)
  }
}

# Extract DEGs for each group using contrast_groups
grouped_DEGs <- extract_DEGs_by_group(de_results_list, contrast_groups)

# Function to match colors based on tissue name
match_colors <- function(names_list, palette) {
  matched_colors <- sapply(names_list, function(name) {
    # Find the first matching tissue in the name
    matched_tissue <- names(palette)[sapply(names(palette), function(t) grepl(t, name))]
    
    # Return the first matching color, or default to black if none found
    if (length(matched_tissue) > 0) {
      return(palette[matched_tissue[1]])  # Use the first match
    } else {
      return("#000000")  # Default black for unmatched names
    }
  })
  
  return(matched_colors)
}
```

Iterate over all groups and contrasts to save the intersection tables.
Excluding groups RedHawk_day5 and Stampede_day5 because they each have 28 contrasts (pairwise tissue contrasts) which is too many for a Venn diagram, and for calculating intersections.
The code didn't work with that many contrasts, so we will exclude them from this. 
```{r}
# Load required library
library(gplots)

# Define output directory
output_dir <- "1.DEAnalysis/output/DEGs_vennintersections/"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Groups to exclude
excluded_groups <- c("RedHawk_day5", "Stampede_day5")

# Iterate over groups (e.g., "Day2", "Day5", etc.)
for (group in names(grouped_DEGs)) {
  
  # Skip excluded groups
  if (group %in% excluded_groups) {
    message(paste("Skipping group:", group, "- too many contrasts for Venn diagram."))
    next
  }
  
  # Iterate over expression categories (e.g., "Upregulated", "Downregulated")
  for (expression_category in names(grouped_DEGs[[group]])) {
    
    # Extract the list of gene sets
    test <- grouped_DEGs[[group]][[expression_category]]
    
    # Check if test has at least two groups for a Venn diagram
    if (length(test) < 2) {
      message(paste("Skipping", group, expression_category, "- insufficient groups"))
      next
    }

    # Debugging: Print progress before running the Venn function
    print(paste("Processing:", group, expression_category, "with", length(test), "sets"))
    flush.console()  # Forces output in R console

    # Try generating Venn diagram
    tryCatch({
      v.table <- venn(test, show.plot = FALSE)  # Avoid plotting

      # Extract intersections
      intersections <- attr(v.table, "intersections")
      
      if (!is.null(intersections)) {
        # Convert intersections list to a data frame
        intersections_df <- stack(intersections)
        colnames(intersections_df) <- c("Gene", "Comparison")
        
        # Define file name
        file_name <- paste0(output_dir, group, "_", expression_category, "_venn_intersections.csv")
        
        # Save to CSV
        write.csv(intersections_df, file_name, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
        
        message(paste("Saved:", file_name))
      } else {
        message(paste("No intersections found for", group, expression_category))
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Error in", group, expression_category, ":", e$message))
    })
  }
}
```

## Iterate over all groups and contrasts to save the intersection tables
Converts the item list into a character column (comma-separated genes).
Replaces / with - in the id column.
Saves each venn_data table as a CSV file.
Stores venn_data as an R object (.rds file) for future use.
```{r}
# Load required libraries
# Load required libraries
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(readr)  # For writing CSV files

# Define output directory
output_dir <- "1.DEAnalysis/output/DEGs_ggvenn_intersections/"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

rds_output_dir <- "1.DEAnalysis/output/DEGs_ggvenn_intersections_RDS/"
if (!dir.exists(rds_output_dir)) dir.create(rds_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Loop through each group in grouped_DEGs
for (group in names(grouped_DEGs)) {
  
  # Loop through Upregulated and Downregulated categories
  for (expression_category in names(grouped_DEGs[[group]])) {
    
    # Extract gene sets
    gene_sets <- grouped_DEGs[[group]][[expression_category]]
    
    # Skip if fewer than two sets (Venn needs at least 2 groups)
    if (length(gene_sets) < 2) {
      message(paste("Skipping", group, expression_category, "- insufficient sets for Venn"))
      next
    }
    
    # Process Venn intersections
    venn_data <- process_region_data(Venn(gene_sets))
    
    # Modify `id` column: replace "/" with "-"
    venn_data$id <- gsub("/", "_", venn_data$id)

    # Convert the `item` column (list of genes) to a single string (comma-separated)
    venn_data$item <- sapply(venn_data$item, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", "))

    # Save as CSV if data is not empty
    if (nrow(venn_data) > 0) {
      # Define file paths
      csv_file <- paste0(output_dir, group, "_", expression_category, "_venn_intersections.csv")
      rds_file <- paste0(rds_output_dir, group, "_", expression_category, "_venn_intersections.rds")
      
      # Write CSV file
      write_csv(venn_data, csv_file)
      
      # Save as RDS object
      saveRDS(venn_data, rds_file)

      message(paste("Saved CSV:", csv_file))
      message(paste("Saved RDS:", rds_file))
    } else {
      message(paste("No intersections found for", group, expression_category))
    }
  }
}

```

## Defining functions to save plots in multiple formats
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Define output paths
output_dir <- "1.DEAnalysis/figures"
formats <- c("png", "pdf", "svg", "tiff")

# Create directories if they don’t exist
for (fmt in formats) {
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, fmt), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Function to save plots in multiple formats
save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600) {
  for (fmt in formats) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(output_dir, fmt, paste0(filename, ".", fmt)),
      plot = plot, 
      width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi
    )
  }
}
```

## Heatmaps of Top 100 and Top 500 DEGs based on log2FoldChange but using VST counts and Z-score scaling for visualization
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)

#2. Identify the Top 100 and 500 DEGs Based on log2FoldChange
# Define threshold for significance
padj_threshold <- 0.05  # Adjusted p-value threshold

# Combine DE results from all conditions into a single dataframe
de_combined <- bind_rows(de_results_list, .id = "Contrast")
str(de_results_list)

# Filter for significant DEGs
de_sig <- de_combined %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)
head(de_sig)

# Select the top 500 and top 100 DEGs based on absolute log2FoldChange
top1000_genes <- de_sig %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(1000) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

top500_genes <- de_sig %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(500) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

top100_genes <- de_sig %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(100) %>%
  pull(gene_id)


#3. Subset VST Counts for Top 100 and Top 500 DEGs
# Extract VST-transformed expression values for the selected DEGs
vsd_top1000 <- assay(vsd_roots)[top1000_genes, ]
vsd_top500 <- assay(vsd_roots)[top500_genes, ]
vsd_top100 <- assay(vsd_roots)[top100_genes, ]

#4. Scale Data for Heatmap Visualization
# Scale counts using Z-score transformation
vsd_top1000 <- t(scale(t(vsd_top1000)))
vsd_top500 <- t(scale(t(vsd_top500)))
vsd_top100 <- t(scale(t(vsd_top100)))
str(vsd_top1000)
#5. Create Sample Annotation Dataframe
annotation_col_roots <- data.frame(
  Day = sampledataord_roots$Day,
  Genotype = sampledataord_roots$Genotype,
  Tissue = sampledataord_roots$Tissue
)

# Ensure row names align with heatmap column names
rownames(annotation_col_roots) <- colnames(vsd_top1000)

# Determine min and max values for proper scaling
min_value_1000 <- min(vsd_top1000, na.rm = TRUE)
max_value_1000 <- max(vsd_top1000, na.rm = TRUE)

min_value_500 <- min(vsd_top500, na.rm = TRUE)
max_value_500 <- max(vsd_top500, na.rm = TRUE)

min_value_100 <- min(vsd_top100, na.rm = TRUE)
max_value_100 <- max(vsd_top100, na.rm = TRUE)

# Set midpoint scaling strategy
midpoint_1000 <- ifelse(min_value_1000 >= 0, mean(vsd_top1000, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
midpoint_500 <- ifelse(min_value_500 >= 0, mean(vsd_top500, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
midpoint_100 <- ifelse(min_value_100 >= 0, mean(vsd_top100, na.rm = TRUE), 0)

# Generate unique breakpoints
paletteLength <- 50  # Define number of color breaks
myColHeatmap <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(paletteLength)
myBreaks_top1000 <- seq(min_value_1000, max_value_1000, length.out = paletteLength)
myBreaks_top500 <- seq(min_value_500, max_value_500, length.out = paletteLength)
myBreaks_top100 <- seq(min_value_100, max_value_100, length.out = paletteLength)

custom_order <- c(1, 2, 4, 3)

custom_clustering <- function(hclust_obj, mat) {
  k <- 4  # Number of clusters
  clusters <- cutree(hclust_obj, k)  # Assign clusters
  
  # Define custom order for clusters
  custom_order <- c(1, 2, 4, 3)
  
  # Create a mapping from old cluster labels to new ones
  new_cluster_labels <- setNames(seq_along(custom_order), custom_order)
  
  # Reorder clusters according to the custom order
  reordered_clusters <- new_cluster_labels[as.character(clusters)]
  
  # Order dendrogram based on the new cluster labels
  new_order <- order(reordered_clusters)
  
  # Convert hclust to dendrogram, reorder, and convert back
  dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust_obj)
  reordered_dend <- reorder(dend, new_order)
  
  return(as.hclust(reordered_dend))
}

#8. Generate Heatmaps for Top 500 and Top 100 DEGs
# Top 500 Heatmap
vsd_top500[1:4,1:4]

heatmap_top500_ord <- pheatmap(vsd_top500,
         annotation_col = annotation_col_roots,  
         annotation_colors = metadata_roots_ann_colors,  
         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
         cluster_cols = TRUE,  
         color = myColHeatmap,#colors_diverging_icefire
         breaks = myBreaks_top500,  
         show_colnames = FALSE,  
         show_rownames = FALSE,  
         border_color = NA,
         cutree_cols = 4,  
         clustering_callback = custom_clustering)  

heatmap_top500_ord
str(vsd_top500)


# Save heatmap
save_plot(heatmap_top500_ord, "heatmap_top500_DEGs_scaledvsdcounts_zscore_clust4_ord", width = 6.3, height = 5)

# Top 100 Heatmap
heatmap_top100_ord <- pheatmap(vsd_top100,
         annotation_col = annotation_col_roots,  
         annotation_colors = metadata_roots_ann_colors,  
         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
         cluster_cols = TRUE,  
         color = myColHeatmap,,  
         breaks = myBreaks_top100,  
         show_colnames = FALSE,  
         show_rownames = FALSE,  
         border_color = NA,
         cutree_cols = 4,  
         clustering_callback = custom_clustering)  

heatmap_top100_ord
# Save heatmap
save_plot(heatmap_top100_ord, "heatmap_top100_DEGs_scaledvsdcounts_zscore_clust4_ord", width = 6.3, height = 5)

```

## Heatmaps of Top 100 and Top 500 DEGs using log2FoldChange for visualization

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Define threshold for significance
padj_threshold <- 0.05  # Adjusted p-value threshold

# Combine DE results from all conditions into a single dataframe
de_combined <- bind_rows(de_results_list, .id = "Contrast")

# Filter for significant DEGs
de_sig <- de_combined %>% filter(padj <= padj_threshold)

# Select the top 500 and top 100 DEGs based on absolute log2FoldChange
top500_genes <- de_sig %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(500) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

top100_genes <- de_sig %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(100) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

# Create a matrix of log2FoldChange values with genes as rows and conditions as columns
logFC_matrix <- de_combined %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% union(top500_genes, top100_genes)) %>%
  select(gene_id, Contrast, log2FoldChange) %>%
  tidyr::spread(Contrast, log2FoldChange)

# Set row names
rownames(logFC_matrix) <- logFC_matrix$gene_id
logFC_matrix <- logFC_matrix[, -1]  # Remove gene column after setting row names

# Subset log2FC matrices for top 100 and 500 genes
logFC_top500 <- logFC_matrix[top500_genes, ]
logFC_top100 <- logFC_matrix[top100_genes, ]

# Scale log2FC values for visualization (optional)
logFC_top500_scaled <- t(scale(t(logFC_top500)))
logFC_top100_scaled <- t(scale(t(logFC_top100)))

# Define color scale for log2FC values
color_palette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(50)

# Generate Heatmap for Top 500 DEGs
pheatmap(logFC_top500_scaled,
         color = color_palette,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         border_color = NA,
         main = "Top 500 DEGs log2FC Heatmap")

# Generate Heatmap for Top 100 DEGs
pheatmap(logFC_top100_scaled,
         color = color_palette,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         border_color = NA,
         main = "Top 100 DEGs log2FC Heatmap")

```
